description: I lost my necklace, and think that guttersnipe Billy Maclure took it!  He's usually scuttling like a rat around the Maclure vineyards east of here.
Get my necklace back for me, and you'll warm an old widow's heart.
completion: You lost a what? Well I didn't take no necklace, because I ain't no thief!
I might know who did but...<grin>...I'm too hungry to remember.
